}

  %be = zext <16 x i8> %b to <16 x i16>

}

  %cmp = icmp eq i64 %indvar.inc, %n
  br i1 %cmp, label %exit, label %loop

exit:                                             ; preds = %loop
  ret i32 %sum
}

@G = external global i1

define i64 @shl_cttz_constant_i64(i64 %y) {
entry:
  %A = alloca i128, align 8
  store i128 1, ptr %A, align 4
  %cttz = call i64 @llvm.cttz.i64(i64 %y, i1 true)
  %L = load i128, ptr %A, align 4
  switch i128 %L, label %SW_D [
    i128 318930731163887670, label %SW_C
    i128 12474326081712352415, label %SW_C1
    i128 9242542644793105854, label %SW_C2
    i128 4830656226561388135, label %SW_C3
    i128 13108546695445346743, label %SW_C4
    i128 12270436321526771585, label %SW_C5
  ]

BB:                                               ; preds = %SW_C5, %SW_C4, %SW_C3, %SW_C2, %SW_C1
  %res = shl i64 4, %cttz
  ret i64 %res

SW_D:                                             ; preds = %entry
  ret i64 -1

SW_C:                                             ; preds = %entry
  ret i64 %cttz

SW_C1:                                            ; preds = %entry
  br label %BB

SW_C2:                                            ; preds = %entry
  br label %BB

SW_C3:                                            ; preds = %entry
  br label %BB

SW_C4:                                            ; preds = %entry
  br label %BB

SW_C5:                                            ; preds = %SW_C5, %entry
  %LGV = load i1, ptr @G, align 1
  br i1 %LGV, label %SW_C5, label %BB
}

; Function Attrs: nocallback nofree nosync nounwind speculatable willreturn memory(none)
declare i64 @llvm.cttz.i64(i64, i1 immarg) #0

attributes #0 = { nocallback nofree nosync nounwind speculatable willreturn memory(none) }
